message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover for TEMPO. The background is a flat, vibrant pink. Large grey letters spell "TEMPO" at the top, with smaller text underneath reading "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". In the upper corners, two red rectangles contain white text: "Wartawan Intel di Sekitar Kita H.90" and "Manuver KPU Meloloskan Peserta Pemilu H.32". At the top right are details including the date "26 DESEMBER 2022-1 JANUARI 2023", the price "RP 50.000", a barcode, and a QR code.

The main focus is five women of various ages arranged in a collage. They are shown from the chest or shoulders up, with their skin and clothing rendered in shades of blue and purple. From left to right: one woman faces forward with a slight smile; behind her, a woman wearing a light-colored hijab and glasses smiles; in the center, a woman wearing a dark hijab and glasses looks slightly upward; above her, a woman in a dark headscarf looks directly forward; on the right, a woman in a nun’s habit and white clerical collar looks slightly to the side. At the bottom, white text reads "TOKOH TEMPO 2022 UNTUK PEREMPUAN UNTUK PARA KORBAN" followed by a paragraph of smaller white text. A silver cross necklace is visible on the woman on the right.
